sql:
SELECT
  t.name AS tenant_name,
  rp.name AS policy_name,
  rp.entity_schema,
  rp.entity_table,
  rp.retention_days,
  rp.action_on_expiry,
  rp.is_active,
  rp.last_run_at
FROM retention_policies rp
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = rp.tenant_id
ORDER BY rp.entity_table, t.name, rp.id
note: Lists every configured retention policy (active and inactive), one row per policy, ordered by entity table then tenant name, as requested. Note: this report may exceed 50 printed rows if there are more than 50 policies across all tenants; the handbook caps printed rows at 50, so the printed report will note total row count if truncated.
